notes:
B5/B6 original sessions (204 tests) documented in prior entry. Round-2 review fixes F1-F5:

F1 (major): Added Source string property to OrderChangedDto + From(order) mapper (order.Source.ToString() — explicit string not enum so SignalR JSON sends 'App'/'Dispatcher'/'Phone' not numbers). Extended Subscribe_OwnerJoinsOrderGroup_ReceivesOrderChanged test to assert source===App on the wire. Backend suite: 255 green.

F2 (major): OrderChangedPayload interface in eventReducer.ts updated to mirror OrderChangedDto field-for-field (9 fields: id, fleetId, publicCode, status, driverId, customerUserId, updatedAt, version, source). source changed from optional (source?) to required string. makeOrderChanged fixture in eventReducer.test.ts updated to include all 9 fields with field-for-field comment. Stale 'server doesn't send source' comments deleted from interface docstring and decideSound docstring.

F5 (minor): applyOrderChanged no longer inserts stubs for unknown order IDs — returns list unchanged when order not found. useFleetHub.ts replaces setQueriesData+orderFoundInCache flag pattern with getQueriesData iteration: per cache entry, if order exists → setQueryData patch; if absent → invalidateQueries with exact:true. Test updated: 'inserts a new order' → 'does NOT insert a new order'. New useFleetHub test seeds two filtered caches and asserts patch vs invalidation.

F4 (minor): useFleetHub.ts start() now uses cold-start retry loop (attemptStart() with setTimeout+getReconnectDelay backoff). On failure: notifyStateListeners('reconnecting') so banner shows and server actions are blocked during all retries. On eventual success: notifyStateListeners('connected') + invalidate orders+drivers for catch-up. Key fix: notifyStateListeners('connecting') called only on the first attempt (startAttempt===0) so that retries stay in 'reconnecting' state — without this, every retry briefly flips to 'connecting' which re-enables server actions while the server is unreachable. hubInstance is assigned before the first start(); the retry loop reuses the same connection object. Test uses vi.useFakeTimers() (cleaned up in afterEach) + advanceTimersByTimeAsync to verify: first 3 calls fail, 4th succeeds, final state is 'connected' with invalidation.

F3 (minor): Deleted EVENT_LABELS and ACTOR_LABELS hardcoded maps from eventTimeline.ts. Deleted getEventLabel() and getActorLabel() exported functions. OrderEventTimeline.tsx updated to use t('orders.timeline.event.'+event.type) and t('orders.timeline.actor.'+event.actorRole) with defaultValue fallback. eventTimeline.test.ts replaced label-map tests with i18n key-coverage tests (6 tests) that iterate ALL_ORDER_EVENT_TYPES and verify keys exist in cs.json+en.json. No i18n JSON edits needed — all 13+4 keys already present from B8.
